name: 松戸富田麺絆
address_ja: 〒100-7090 東京都千代田区丸の内2-7-2 KITTE丸の内 B1F
cuisine: The Tokyo Station outpost of Matsudo's 中華蕎麦とみ田 — the 濃厚豚骨魚介 tsukemen that made Osamu Tomita famous, plus jumbo gyōza, over a 27-seat counter at ¥1,000–1,999
neighborhood: Marunouchi 2-chōme, basement of KITTE inside the JP Tower — 2 min from Tokyo Station (JR / Marunouchi line), 3 min from the Keiyō line's underground exit 9; 247 m from the station
gf_detail: Wheat is the product. The group's own site states the noodles are made from 厳選した上質な国産小麦のみ — selected domestic wheat only, 特等粉 blended for the thick house noodle — and the tsukemen dip is a 20-hour pork-bone-and-fish broth finished with ordinary wheat shōyu tare. The gyōza are wheat wrappers fried in the same kitchen. There is no gluten-free item and no allergen handling published. Not workable for celiac.
vegan_detail: Pork-bone and dried-fish broth, chāshū from TOKYO X / Kagoshima black pork, pork gyōza. Nothing on the menu is plant-based and none is claimed.

roles: 代表 (founder / owner-chef of 中華蕎麦とみ田)
心の味食品株式会社 principal
chef_bio.background: 中華蕎麦とみ田 opened as a single shop in Matsudo, Chiba, and became the most decorated tsukemen house in Japan — the reason a Tokyo Station branch exists at all. Tomita's signature is a 超濃厚豚骨魚介スープ simmered more than twenty hours until it coats a spoon, lifted at the end with a trace of yuzu so the density reads as clean rather than heavy, and a 自家製極太麺 milled from selected domestic wheat including 特等粉-grade flour, deliberately pale, sweet and chewy. The parent company 心の味食品株式会社 now supplies noodles and soup to other well-known ramen shops as well as running the group's own branches, and Tomita runs the 真ラーメン祭り絆 event. The KITTE shop, opened 5 March 2019, is the 麺絆 ('noodle bond') format — Matsudo's bowl on a 27-seat counter that has to turn quickly, with jumbo gyōza added. Reviewers consistently report a 10–20 person queue at lunch, much of it inbound tourists.
chef_bio.philosophy: 「お客様に最高の一杯を差し上げること」— to hand the customer the single best bowl possible, and to treat the shop as 「人」と「空間」 rather than a noodle dispenser.
chef_bio.specialty: 濃厚つけ麺 (pork-bone/fish dip, thick house noodles, yuzu), ジャンボ餃子

anecdotes.text: The group's own copy explains the noodle as 厳選した上質な国産小麦のみを使用。特等粉クラスの他、数種類をブレンドして、色味の白い美しい麺に仕上げております — a deliberately white, sweet, sticky noodle from blended top-grade domestic wheat.
Tabelog's 丸の内×ラーメン ranking puts 松戸富田麺絆 third in the neighbourhood at 3.71 across 3,717 reviews, behind 六厘舎 東京駅東京ラーメンストリート and ニッポン ラーメン 凛 トウキョウ.
A 2026 reviewer on the jumbo gyōza: 「土曜日14:40／並び10名。並んでいるうちにどんどん人が来て20名くらいの行列に」— the queue at KITTE builds while you stand in it.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: tomita-cocoro.jp (the group's official site) carries the wheat statement, the 20-hour broth description, Tomita's own message as 代表, and the 心の味食品 OEM business. Tabelog 13232095 gives the address 東京都千代田区丸の内2-7-2 KITTE丸の内 B1F, phone 03-6259-1133, the open date 2019年3月5日, 27 counter seats, 予約不可, カード不可 / 交通系電子マネー可, and the weekday/weekend hours split.

gf_cross_contamination.text: A 27-seat counter boiling wheat noodles continuously and frying wheat-wrapper gyōza. One kitchen, one noodle boiler, no wheat-free line of any kind.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: Ordinary wheat shōyu tare assumed throughout; no tamari is mentioned anywhere on the group's site or the listing.

vegan_cross_contact.text: Pork-bone and dried-fish broth is the entire product; pork chāshū and pork gyōza on every ticket.

cultural_comfort.note: A basement counter inside KITTE, directly connected to Tokyo Station, with heavy inbound-tourist traffic, so a non-Japanese speaker will not stand out. No reservations, no cards (transit IC such as Suica only, and no QR payment), and a queue that regularly runs 10–20 people at lunch. Solo diners are the norm — it is all counter. Children of primary-school age are accepted and takeaway is offered.

enrich_note: Confirmed. Yahoo Japan name search surfaced the Tabelog listing; s.tabelog.com/tokyo/A1302/A130201/13232095/ fetched with an iPhone UA (HTTP 200) gives the street address, phone, hours, seat count and open date, and carries GeoCoordinates 35.67957248871671 / 139.7652800343685, which replace the neighborhood-centroid pin. The group's own site tomita-cocoro.jp (HTTP 200) confirms the brand, the chef and the all-wheat noodle. loc_precise set true.

name: 鶏soba 座銀 KITTE丸の内店
address_ja: 〒100-7090 東京都千代田区丸の内2-7-2 KITTE丸の内 B1F
cuisine: Osaka's Tabelog-Hyakumeiten chicken-paitan shop in a Tokyo Station basement — a creamy Sakurajima-chicken potage bowl crowned with a tangle of deep-fried burdock, ¥1,120–1,630
neighborhood: Marunouchi 2-chōme, KITTE basement (JP Tower) — about 1 min from Tokyo Station's Tokyo Central Post Office exit, 240 m from the station; Marunouchi line connects underground
gf_detail: Wheat noodles in every bowl, and the menu is built on 地鶏醤油soba and a chicken-paitan tare — ordinary wheat shōyu, with no tamari named. The signature burdock topping is deep-fried, and that fryer also turns out karaage (唐揚げ3個 ¥350), which in a Japanese ramen kitchen is effectively always wheat flour or wheat-containing karaage-ko. Nothing gluten-free is claimed and there is no rice-noodle option.
vegan_detail: The entire concept is a chicken-bone paitan — 鹿児島県産の桜島鶏のみを使用し、丁寧に仕込んだ濃厚な白湯. Chāshū, smoked egg and seared-meat sushi are the standard toppings. Nothing plant-based is offered or claimed.

roles: brand of 株式会社銀の葡萄 (Osaka; 代表取締役 壽量健太)
Tokyo branches operated under licence — the Kagurazaka shop by フルスイング株式会社
chef_bio.origin: Higobashi, Nishi-ku, Osaka — 鶏 soba 座銀 本店
chef_bio.background: 座銀 began in Higobashi, Osaka, and was selected for Tabelog's ラーメン WEST 百名店. Its stated concept is 「大切な人を連れて行きたいラーメン店」 — a ramen shop you would take someone who matters to — built by borrowing the service and the room of a high-end French restaurant and delivering them over a ¥1,000 bowl; the group's own phrase is 高級ではなく上質 (not luxury, quality). The rooms are black, deliberately modern and above all clean, so that a woman eating alone is comfortable, which is unusual positioning in the ramen trade. The bowl uses only Kagoshima Sakurajima chicken, simmered into a paitan the shop describes as potage-like, and is made instantly recognisable on social media by a standing tangle of lightly deep-fried burdock. The parent, 株式会社銀の葡萄, runs 麺's room 神虎 and 座銀 plus izakaya formats — around twenty outlets — under the mission 「世界一かっこいいラーメン屋」. The KITTE Marunouchi shop opened 20 August 2024 with 19 seats, counter and tables; no individual chef is named for this branch.
chef_bio.philosophy: 「大切な人を連れて行きたいラーメン店」— an experience-led ramen shop; 高級≠上質, quality of service and space rather than expense.
chef_bio.specialty: 鶏soba (Sakurajima-chicken paitan with fried burdock), 地鶏醤油soba, 鶏つけsoba, 鶏白湯まぜsoba; at KITTE, 鶏soba＋炙り肉寿司 ¥1,630 tax-in.

anecdotes.text: The KITTE shop page advertises 鶏soba＋炙り肉寿司 at ¥1,630 — the creamy Sakurajima-chicken bowl paired with seared 'brisket' sushi.
A 2026 Tabelog reviewer came to KITTE for the tantanmen shop 阿吽, found it gone, and ate here instead: 「東京駅KITTE地下を歩けば、食べログ百名店が軒を連ねる魅惑のグルメ街…ごぼうの素揚げが大胆にそびえ立つ印象的なビジュアル」.
The brand describes the burdock as its signature: 一目で同店のラーメンだとわかるトッピングの素揚げのゴボウ.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: Tabelog 13300520 (flagged 公式 — hours published by the operator) gives 東京都千代田区丸の内2-7-2 KITTE丸の内 B1F, phone 03-5860-3699, 19 seats, 予約不可, open date 2024年8月20日, and links the KITTE shop page as the homepage. The KITTE page confirms the B1 location, the phone and a ¥1,630 set, but publishes earlier closing times than Tabelog. fullswing-inc.com's 座銀 神楽坂 page carries the brand concept, the Sakurajima-chicken paitan description, the fried-burdock signature and the full price list. Japanese press (PR TIMES / TUNAG, April 2024) identifies the operator as 株式会社銀の葡萄, Osaka, 代表取締役 壽量健太.

gf_cross_contamination.text: Nineteen seats, one noodle boiler running wheat noodles all day, and a shared fryer used for both the signature burdock and the karaage side.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: A 地鶏醤油soba sits on the menu beside the paitan; wheat shōyu tare throughout, no tamari named.

vegan_cross_contact.text: Kagoshima Sakurajima chicken bones are the base of every bowl; chāshū, smoked egg and seared meat sushi are the toppings.

positives.text: The brand's whole positioning is calm service in a clean, quiet black-toned room rather than a shouted ramen counter, which makes asking a question at the pass less daunting than usual.

cultural_comfort.note: Basement of KITTE, directly connected to Tokyo Station, in a corridor of Tabelog-Hyakumeiten ramen shops with photo menus and constant foreign traffic. No reservations taken; expect a queue at lunch. The brand deliberately builds for solo diners and for people who would not normally enter a ramen shop, so a quiet question is fine — but nothing about allergen handling is published, and this bowl is not workable for celiac regardless.

enrich_note: Confirmed. Yahoo Japan name search returned Tabelog 13300520; fetched from s.tabelog.com with an iPhone UA (HTTP 200) for the address, phone, 19 seats, the 2024-08-20 open date and GeoCoordinates 35.67973649871658 / 139.76521033437018, replacing the centroid pin. The KITTE landlord page (HTTP 200) independently confirms the shop is trading at B1 and gives a current price. hours_status is 'irregular' because Tabelog's operator-published closing times (22:30 / 21:30) and KITTE's published times (22:00 / 21:00) disagree. loc_precise set true.

name: 天ぷら つな八 丸の内オアゾ店
address_ja: 〒100-0005 東京都千代田区丸の内1-6-4 丸の内オアゾ 5F
cuisine: Edo-style tempura fried in sesame oil by a house founded in Shinjuku in 1924 — a ¥1,000–1,999 lunch teishoku or a ¥4,000–7,999 evening course, at a counter or in a small private room a minute from Tokyo Station
neighborhood: Marunouchi 1-chōme, 5th floor of the Marunouchi Oazo building — 1 min on foot from JR Tokyo Station's Marunouchi north side, 320 m from Ōtemachi (Tokyo Metro)
hours_raw: 11:00 - 22:00（L.O. 21:00）毎日。定休日：丸の内オアゾに準じます／無休（但し、1/1及び法定点検日は除く）
gf_detail: A tempura specialist: wheat batter is the dish, and the tentsuyu, ten-don and ten-cha sauces are wheat shōyu and mirin over bonito dashi. Everything comes out of oil that has fried wheat batter all day. The house makes no gluten-free claim and publishes no allergen chart — the only dietary page on the corporate site is a calorie table. There is no version of this meal a celiac can eat.
vegan_detail: Prawn, kisu, anago and squid are the centre of every course; Tabelog files the kitchen under 魚料理にこだわる. Vegetable tempura exists inside the sets, but the batter contains egg and the dipping tsuyu is bonito dashi. No vegan course is offered or claimed.

roles: 天ぷら新宿つな八 (Tempura Shinjuku Tsunahachi), founded 1924
branch of a 23-restaurant group; no individual chef named for the Oazo counter
chef_bio.origin: Kadotsuka, Shinjuku, Tokyo — the original 1924 shop
chef_bio.background: つな八 opened in Shinjuku Kadotsuka in 大正13年 (1924) and is now one of the older surviving tempura houses in Tokyo, running 23 restaurants as of the end of January 2026 — Shinjuku, the wider capital region, and Sapporo, Toyama, Nagoya, Kyoto and Osaka — plus three delicatessen counters in department-store food halls. Its trade mark is that it has fried in sesame oil since the founding (天ぷら油は創業以来ヘルシーなごま油を使用しています), which gives the Edo-mae style its darker, more fragrant crust, and its stated creed is 「おいしさに真心をそえて」, to add sincerity to good taste. The Oazo branch is a recent opening, 20 March 2025, on the fifth floor of the Marunouchi Oazo building a minute from Tokyo Station: 41 seats including a counter, private rooms for 2, 4, 6 and 8 and a maximum party of 12, English and photo menus, sake, shōchū and wine. No chef is named publicly for this branch; the group presents itself as a house style rather than a personality. The group is contracting at the edges as well as expanding — the Kinshichō branch closed on 31 August 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: 「おいしさに真心をそえて」— a century of unchanged sesame-oil frying and selected seasonal ingredients, served without ceremony.
chef_bio.specialty: 江戸前天ぷら fried in sesame oil; lunch tempura teishoku; kaiseki-style tempura courses in the evening.

anecdotes.text: The corporate site's own summary: 大正13年、新宿角筈の地に店を構えて以来…全国に23店舗（令和8年1月末現在）— a century in business and still counting outlets.
Mitsubishi Estate's tenant page for the Oazo shop describes it as 大正13年創業の天ぷら専門店 using 特別誂えの「天ぷら油」, a specially commissioned frying oil, and lists 41 seats.
A 2025 Tabelog reviewer simply titled the visit 「1924年（大正13年）創業の天ぷら屋さん」, which is how the shop reads to Japanese diners: heritage at department-store prices.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: Mitsubishi Estate's marunouchi.com tenant page 20047 lists the shop as 天ぷら つな八, 丸の内オアゾ 5F, 東京都千代田区丸の内1-6-4, 11:00–22:00 (LO 21:00), 03-6665-9788, 41 seats, closed only 1 January and statutory inspection days. Tabelog 13306830 gives the same address and phone, the open date 2025年3月20日, 38 seats, private rooms to 12, English and photo menus, and budget bands ¥4,000–4,999 dinner / ¥1,000–1,999 lunch. tunahachi.co.jp carries the 1924 founding, the 23-restaurant count, the sesame-oil statement and the creed — though its own store list has not yet been updated to include the Oazo branch, which is why the landlord page was used to confirm the shop is trading.

gf_cross_contamination.text: Wheat batter is the entire product and one bank of sesame-oil fryers serves the whole room. There is no separate oil, no gluten-free batter, and no allergen chart published — only a calorie table.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: Tentsuyu, ten-don and ten-cha sauces are wheat shōyu and mirin on bonito dashi; no tamari is named anywhere on the group's site.

vegan_cross_contact.text: Tabelog records the kitchen as 魚料理にこだわる; prawn, whitefish and anago run through every set, and the dipping tsuyu is bonito dashi.

positives.text: English and photo menus are listed, reservations are taken, and there are private rooms for 2 to 12 — a much easier room in which to raise a dietary question than a ramen counter, even though the answer here is no.

cultural_comfort.note: Fifth-floor restaurant in the Marunouchi Oazo building, one minute from Tokyo Station, with English and picture menus, reservations by phone (03-6665-9788), a full smoking ban, strollers and children of all ages accepted, and private rooms. Lunch is a plain, cheap teishoku at ¥1,000–1,999; dinner rises to ¥4,000–7,999. Open every day the building is, closing only for New Year's Day and statutory inspections.

enrich_note: Confirmed, with a small name normalisation to the landlord's signage (天ぷら つな八 丸の内オアゾ店). Yahoo Japan returned Tabelog 13306830 and Mitsubishi Estate's marunouchi.com tenant page; both fetched HTTP 200 and agree on 東京都千代田区丸の内1-6-4 丸の内オアゾ 5F, 11:00–22:00 (LO 21:00) and 03-6665-9788. Tabelog's GeoCoordinates 35.68401602476108 / 139.7666452712015 replace the centroid pin. One caution worth recording: tunahachi.co.jp's own 店舗一覧 does NOT list an Oazo branch (for Chiyoda it lists only 大丸東京店), so the corporate store list is stale; the landlord tenant page and the Tabelog listing, with a matching phone number, are what establish the shop is trading. Seat count differs between sources (41 on marunouchi.com, 38 on Tabelog). loc_precise set true.

name: 秋田比内地鶏生産責任者の店 本家あべや KITTE GRANCHE店
address_ja: 〒100-7090 東京都千代田区丸の内2-7-2 JPタワー KITTE丸の内 B1F
cuisine: Akita's Hinai-jidori specialist under Tokyo Station — kiritanpo hot pot, charcoal yakitori and the 究極の親子丼, made with the producer's own free-range birds; ¥1,000–1,999 at lunch, ¥4,000–4,999 in the evening
neighborhood: Marunouchi 2-chōme, the KITTE GRANCHE food floor in the JP Tower basement — 1 min from Tokyo Station's Marunouchi south exit, connected underground to the Marunouchi line; 2 min from Nijūbashimae (Chiyoda line), 4 min from Ōtemachi (Mita line)
gf_detail: No gluten-free claim and no allergen chart. The house dishes are built on wheat soy sauce — the 親子丼 warishita, the kiritanpo-nabe broth (Akita's version is a shōyu-and-chicken-stock soup) and the yakitori tare are all wheat shōyu, and the group's own fermentation project turns unused chicken parts into 鶏醤, a chicken 'fish sauce' whose wheat content is not published. Kiritanpo itself is pounded rice, and shio-grilled skewers of a bird this good are a plausible ask, so this is not a flat no — but it needs a Japanese conversation at the counter about tare, and nothing published supports going in blind.
vegan_detail: A Hinai-jidori producer's own restaurant: chicken stock, chicken skewers, chicken-and-egg donburi. There is no plant-based course and none is claimed.

roles: 本家あべや — restaurant arm of a 比内地鶏 producer in Ōdate, Akita
operates ひないフードファクトリー, the group's processing and fermentation base
chef_bio.origin: Hinai-machi, Ōdate City, Akita Prefecture, at the foot of the Ōu mountains
chef_bio.background: あべや is a Hinai-jidori specialist that raises and processes its own birds and then sells them across its own counters — the shop's full trading name, 秋田比内地鶏生産責任者の店, literally means 'the shop of the person responsible for producing Akita Hinai-jidori'. Hinai-jidori descends from the 比内鶏, a designated natural monument, and is one of Japan's three great table birds; the group's stated standard is free range for at least 150 days, which is what gives the meat its fine grain and depth. Its production base, ひないフードファクトリー, is a closed former primary school (旧大葛小学校) in Hinai-machi rebuilt as a 完全循環 facility: stock drawn with local spring water, unused parts fermented with indigenous microbes into 鶏醤, residue composted back onto the group's own farm. A newer line, HINAI75, uses the 75–80-day cockerels that fall outside the Hinai-jidori brand standard and would otherwise be wasted, turning their collagen and amino acids into stock. The KITTE branch — the group's own signage calls it 本家あべや KITTE丸の内店, while Tabelog files it as KITTE GRANCHE店 — opened 21 March 2013 with the building and seats 50. No individual chef is named; the identity is the producer's, not a cook's.
chef_bio.philosophy: 「風水火が醸す、比内地鶏の真髄」— wind, water and fire do the cooking and the human only assists; use every part of the bird and return what is left to the land.
chef_bio.specialty: きりたんぽ鍋, 究極の親子丼 / 極上の親子丼, 水炊き, charcoal yakitori of Hinai-jidori; Akita junmai sake at the group's sister bars.

anecdotes.text: The group rebuilt a closed rural primary school, 旧大葛小学校 in Hinai-machi, as its food factory and describes it as the 心臓部 of a complete cycle — stock, then fermented 鶏醤 from unused parts, then compost back to its own fields.
HINAI75 exists because the brand standard excludes young cockerels: 日齢75〜80日の若い雄鶏は比内地鶏ブランド認定基準を満たさず — so the group built a separate product line around them rather than discard them.
Tabelog records the shop as a 神泡認定店 — certified by Suntory for how it pours its draught beer — and reviewers turn up as much for that and the 2.5-hour nomihōdai course as for the chicken.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: honkeabeya.com's store page gives 〒100-7090 東京都千代田区丸の内2丁目7-2 JPタワーkitte B1, phone 03-6256-0822, weekday 11:00–23:00 (LO 22:30) / weekend and holiday 11:00–22:00 (LO 21:30), closed only New Year's Day and statutory inspection days, and the walking directions from Tokyo Station's Marunouchi south exit, Nijūbashimae and Ōtemachi. The site's front page carries the Hinai-jidori provenance, the 150-day free-range standard, the ひないフードファクトリー circular-production account and the HINAI75 line. Tabelog 13153694 confirms the address as KITTE B1F, 50 seats, the open date 2013年3月21日, the budget bands and the homepage link.

gf_cross_contamination.text: A 50-seat izakaya-style room serving donburi, nabe and grilled skewers together. No gluten-free handling, no allergen chart and no dedicated equipment is published.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: The signature dishes are seasoned with wheat shōyu — oyakodon warishita, kiritanpo-nabe broth and yakitori tare. The group also makes its own fermented 鶏醤 seasoning; whether it contains wheat is not published.

vegan_cross_contact.text: Chicken stock is the base of every dish on the menu, including the nabe; the shop exists to sell its own birds.

positives.text: Kiritanpo is pounded rice rather than a wheat product, and a shio-grilled skewer is a normal thing to order here — so there is at least a conversation to be had, unlike at a noodle counter.
Reservations are accepted and there is an online booking channel, which makes it possible to raise a dietary requirement before arriving rather than at the door.

cultural_comfort.note: Easy to reach — KITTE's basement food floor is directly under Tokyo Station and the room is a large, brightly signed 50-seat izakaya open until 23:00 on weekdays, so walking in alone or with a group is unremarkable. Reservations are taken by phone (03-6256-0822) and online. Where Japanese helps is the dietary conversation: nothing about allergens is published, so establishing that a skewer is salt-grilled and that no tare has touched it has to be asked, in Japanese, at the counter. Closed only on 1 January and building inspection days.

enrich_note: Confirmed; the light record's long name is the shop's real registered trading name, not a garbling. Yahoo Japan returned Tabelog 13153694 and honkeabeya.com; both fetched HTTP 200. Tabelog gives 東京都千代田区丸の内2-7-2 KITTE B1F, 50 seats, open date 2013年3月21日 and GeoCoordinates 35.679513437911254 / 139.76488918320638, which replace the centroid pin; the group's own store page gives the postcode, the phone 03-6256-0822 and slightly later last orders than Tabelog. Worth knowing for display: the operator's own signage calls this branch 本家あべや KITTE丸の内店 — 'KITTE GRANCHE' is the name of the basement food zone, which is how Tabelog files it. loc_precise set true.

name: Ta-im 丸の内店
address_ja: 〒100-0005 東京都千代田区丸の内3-2-3 丸の内二重橋ビル B1F
cuisine: Ebisu's Israeli home-cooking house in a Marunouchi basement — seven kinds of hummus eaten with warm pita, chickpea falafel, shakshuka off the iron pan and Golan Heights wine; ¥1,000–1,999 at lunch, ¥4,000–4,999 at night
neighborhood: Marunouchi 3-chōme, basement of the Marunouchi Nijūbashi Building (Nijūbashi Square) — 1 min from Nijūbashimae (Tokyo Metro Chiyoda line), 277 m; about 8 min from Hibiya (Toei Mita / Tokyo Metro Hibiya lines)
gf_detail: No gluten-free claim, no allergen chart, and wheat is very present: pita is baked into the concept and most dips arrive with it — the ババガヌシュ and マッブッハ are listed 「ピタパン1／2付き」 and the 3種のディップ platter includes ピタパン — while the タブリサラダ is tabbouleh, which is cracked wheat (bulgur). Against that, this is one of the few Marunouchi kitchens where a naturally wheat-free order genuinely exists: plain hummus (¥980) is chickpea, tahini, lemon and olive oil, and the menu describes the イスラエルサラダ as nothing but diced tomato and cucumber with fresh lemon juice, olive oil, parsley, mint and za'atar. Israeli-style falafel is a ground-chickpea fritter rather than a battered one, but the binder is not published and the fryer is shared. Nothing here is claimed as celiac-safe, so this is an ask: order ピタ抜き explicitly, avoid the tabbouleh, and query the falafel.
vegan_detail: Real options, stated by the shop rather than inferred. The branch's own page says the hummus and falafel are 「ヴィーガンにも対応できる」, the gnavi official page repeats 「ヴィーガンにも対応できる料理を多数ご用意しております」, and Tabelog files the kitchen under ベジタリアンメニューあり. The Tabelog course copy adds that for the ¥4,000 seven-course they will swap the meat dish for vegetarians on request — 「ベジタリアンの方へのお肉料理変更などは、ご要望をお聞きした上で…可能な限り対応いたします」 — while noting that a substitution for a single diner inside a group course is declined. Hummus, baba ganoush, matbucha, Israeli salad and falafel are plant-based as served; the lamb and chicken hummus variants and the lamb plate are not.

chef_bio.chef_name: ダン・ズッカーマン (Dan Zuckerman)
roles: オーナーシェフ (owner-chef), Ta-im 恵比寿本店
founder of the Marunouchi branch, opened 8 November 2018
chef_bio.background: Ta-im began in Ebisu, Shibuya-ku, as owner-chef Dan Zuckerman's Israeli home-cooking restaurant, and the Marunouchi shop — announced on the group's own site as 「恵比寿に本店を構えるオーナーシェフ、ダン・ズッカーマン氏のイスラエル家庭料理の初支店」 — was its first branch, opening 8 November 2018 in the basement of the Marunouchi Nijūbashi Building. The room is built around a blue taken from the Israeli sky, deliberately close between staff and guests, and the kitchen leans on spice and herb rather than richness: seven hummus variations from plain through coriander, garlic sprout, mushroom, spicy tomato, lamb and chicken; falafel by the two, four or six; shakshuka off the iron pan; and Israeli wine from the Golan Heights alongside Israeli beer. It is not a fine-dining project — the shop's own framing is home cooking — and what recurs in Japanese reviews is not technique but that the hummus is the best in Tokyo's Middle Eastern field. The Ebisu original still trades under ta-imebisu.com.
chef_bio.philosophy: Israeli home cooking as it is eaten at home — herb- and spice-led, healthy, and plant-forward enough that vegans can be fed without a separate menu.
chef_bio.specialty: フムス (seven variations), ファラフェル, シャクシュカ, ババガヌシュ, マッブッハ, イスラエルサラダ, Golan Heights wine.

anecdotes.text: The branch's own launch page frames the food through the health-food trend: 「欧米やセレブの間でも大人気のヘルシーフード、ヴィーガンにも対応できるスパイスやハーブを大胆に使ったこだわりの『フムス』や『ファラフェル』とイスラエル産ワインをお楽しみください」.
A 2026 Tabelog reviewer on the hummus: 「Ta-im さんは今のところ中近東系のレストランで一番美味しいフムスが頂けるお店です」 — the best hummus they have found in a Middle Eastern restaurant in Tokyo.

The menu's own wording is the best guide to what is safe here: the Israeli salad is 「トマト・きゅうりの細かいさいの目切り、フレッシュレモン汁＋オリーブオイル、イタリアンパセリた～っぷり、ミント、ザタル（ハーブ）」 — vegetables, lemon, oil and herbs and nothing else.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: ta-im.com is the Marunouchi branch's own page and carries the 2018年11月8日 opening, the Ebisu parentage, owner-chef Dan Zuckerman's name and the vegan-capable claim. Tabelog 13228195 (flagged 公式, information published by the operator) gives 東京都千代田区丸の内3-2-3 丸の内二重橋ビル B1F, phone 03-6268-0985, 32 seats, closed Sundays, all-non-smoking, cards / IC / QR accepted, 複数言語メニューあり（英語、中国語簡体字）, ベジタリアンメニューあり and GeoCoordinates 35.67770793791139 / 139.76174378319038. The gnavi official page (gb46052.gorp.jp, shop 0001647995) gives postcode 100-0005, the same street address, English menu and English-speaking staff, 30 seats, 店内全面禁煙, 車いすでトイレ利用可, お子様連れNG and a different dinner schedule; its menu pages carry the hummus, dip, falafel and salad prices.

gf_cross_contamination.text: Pita runs through most of the menu — the dips are listed 「ピタパン1／2付き」 and the three-dip platter includes it — so bread is on the same plates and the same table by default. The falafel comes out of a shared fryer. No allergen chart is published.
The タブリサラダ sits on the same salad list as the wheat-free Israeli salad. Tabbouleh is bulgur — cracked wheat — so the two must not be confused when ordering.

vegan_cross_contact.text: Lamb and chicken hummus variants and a lamb plate come out of the same kitchen and the same fryer as the falafel; the shop offers vegan-capable dishes but publishes no separation.

staff_allergy_handling.text: The kitchen states in its own course copy that it takes dietary requests in advance and adjusts within budget: 「ベジタリアンの方へのお肉料理変更などは、ご要望をお聞きした上で、お料理の追加などご予算に応じて可能な限り対応いたします。お気軽にご相談ください。※お一人様分の変更等はお断りしております」.

positives.text: English menus and English-speaking staff are listed on the gnavi official page, and Tabelog records 複数言語メニューあり（英語、中国語簡体字）plus a digital menu — so the dietary conversation can be had in English, which is unusual in this neighbourhood.
Reservations are accepted, including online, so a request can be made before arriving rather than at the door.

cultural_comfort.note: A 32-seat basement room under Nijūbashi Square, one minute from Nijūbashimae, entirely non-smoking, taking cards, transit IC and QR payment, with English menus and English-speaking staff listed and a wheelchair-accessible toilet. Lunch fills fast — a 2026 reviewer records the counter and tables full by noon — but a weekday walk-in at 11:00 is fine. Two cautions from the listings themselves: it is closed on Sundays, and the gnavi official page states お子様連れNG (no children), which contradicts Tabelog's 家族・子供と tag, so families should ring 03-6268-0985 first.

enrich_note: Confirmed. Yahoo Japan name search returned the shop's own site, the gnavi official page and Tabelog 13228195; all fetched HTTP 200. Tabelog (flagged 公式) and gnavi agree on 東京都千代田区丸の内3-2-3 丸の内二重橋ビルB1 and phone 03-6268-0985. Tabelog's GeoCoordinates 35.67770793791139 / 139.76174378319038 replace the neighborhood-centroid pin; gnavi's JSON-LD gives 35.67772809763267 / 139.76141915828384, about 26 m away, which is the same building entrance. hours_status is 'irregular' because the two official channels disagree on dinner service (Tabelog 17:30–22:00 Mon–Thu vs gnavi 17:30–23:00 Mon–Fri), on seat count (32 vs 30) and on children (子供可 vs お子様連れNG). loc_precise set true.

name: 東京煮干し らーめん玉 東京駅店
address_ja: 〒100-0005 東京都千代田区丸の内1-9-1 東京駅一番街 B1F 東京ラーメンストリート
cuisine: Kawasaki's 玉 group doing niboshi on Tokyo Ramen Street — a thick chicken-and-dried-sardine 濃厚とろりそば under a cloud of paper-thin bonito shavings cut to order on a one-of-a-kind machine, from 08:30; ¥1,000–1,999
neighborhood: Marunouchi 1-chōme, Tokyo Ramen Street on the B1 of Tokyo Station Ichibangai — 124 m from Tokyo Station; down the stairs immediately left of the Yaesu south ticket gate, or right out of the Yaesu underground central gate
hours_raw: 月・火・水・木・金・土・日・祝日・祝前日・祝後日 08:30 - 23:00（L.O. 22:30）。定休日：施設に準ずる（グループ公式サイトは8:30～23:00、L.O.22:30 と同一表記）
gf_detail: The group publishes a per-item allergen line for this branch and it settles the question: 中華そば — 小麦、豚肉、鶏肉、大豆、さば、卵、えび、かに. Wheat is in the noodle by design — the opening release advertises 「香り高く、小麦の強い風味が楽しめる自家特製麺」, a house noodle chosen for how strongly the wheat reads — and the tare is soy-based (大豆) wheat shōyu with no tamari named. The only wheat-free line on the group's own chart is the rice: かつお節ごはん and 肉飯 list 卵、豚肉、大豆、さば、えび、かに and no 小麦, but they are sides in a 30-seat shop boiling wheat noodles continuously, and no separation is claimed. Not workable for celiac.
vegan_detail: The bowl is chicken stock plus a large charge of dried sardine, finished with shaved 枕崎産のサバ節 (Kagoshima mackerel節) over the top and pork chāshū in it — the published allergen line for 中華そば includes 豚肉, 鶏肉 and さば. Nothing plant-based is offered and none is claimed.

roles: 株式会社 玉 代表取締役 (founder and president of the 玉-GYOKU- group)
chef_bio.background: Tamagawa taught himself ramen and opened つけめん玉 in Kawasaki in 2008 with a combination — a very thick broth against a wide, flat, extra-thick noodle — that the group's own press describes as having overturned what the trade then assumed a bowl should be. From that one shop grew 三三㐂, 赤備, 超大吉 and バラそば屋, and today around twenty outlets across Tokyo, Kanagawa, Aichi, Fukuoka, Okinawa and Taiwan, still headquartered in Kawasaki-ku. The Tokyo Station shop, opened 30 October 2018, was built as a niboshi specialist rather than a copy of the flagship: chicken stock carried to a heavy concentration and then loaded with several kinds of dried sardine, which the release calls 「鶏と煮干しの黄金比」. Its visual signature is the 極薄削り節 — bonito and mackerel節 shaved to order in the shop on what the company says is the only machine of its type in existence, so that it spreads across the bowl and dissolves in the mouth. Tamagawa's stated goal is 「らーめんを世界へ」.
chef_bio.philosophy: 「らーめんを世界へ」— take ramen out to the world; and treat dashi as the thing being sold, with the shavings cut to order rather than in advance.
chef_bio.specialty: 濃厚とろりそば (thick niboshi), 中華そば, 【東京駅限定】濃厚金目鯛そば, 削りたて節ごはん.

anecdotes.text: The opening release explains the shaving machine as the reason the bowl looks the way it does: 「世界に一台しかない特注削り機」で注文をいただいてから店内で都度削る — cut to order, in the shop, on a one-off machine.
Tamagawa's own profile: 「神奈川県川崎市出身。独学でラーメンを作り続け、2008年『つけめん玉』を開業。濃厚スープに極太平打麺という、現在の玉のスタイルは、当時のラーメン業界の概念を覆した」.

The shop has been running long enough for regulars to track its prices: a 2026 Tabelog reviewer notes 特製とろりラーメン is now ¥1,330 and reads it against 原材料費高騰 and the Tokyo minimum-wage rise rather than as a grievance.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: Tabelog 13227565 (flagged 公式) gives 東京都千代田区丸の内1-9-1 東京駅一番街 B1F 東京ラーメンストリート, phone 03-6551-2205, 30 counter seats, 予約不可, カード不可 / 交通系電子マネー可 / QR不可, all-non-smoking, open date 2018年10月30日, homepage gyoku.co.jp, and GeoCoordinates 35.68006969871725 / 139.76797347437162. The group's own branch page (gyoku.co.jp/contents/category/tokyo) repeats the address, phone and 8:30–23:00 hours, carries the current price list and publishes the per-item allergen lines. The PR TIMES release of 27 October 2018 from 株式会社 玉 gives the founding history, the chairman's profile, the original opening hours (10:30–23:00, since moved earlier), the Makurazaki mackerel節 and the one-off shaving machine.

gf_cross_contamination.text: Thirty counter seats and one noodle boiler running wheat noodles from 08:30 to 23:00. No wheat-free line, no separate equipment and no cross-contact statement is published alongside the allergen list.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: The published allergen line for 中華そば includes 大豆 and 小麦; the tare is ordinary wheat shōyu and no tamari is named anywhere on the group's site.

vegan_cross_contact.text: Chicken stock, dried sardine, pork chāshū and mackerel節 shaved over the finished bowl — 豚肉, 鶏肉 and さば all appear in the shop's own allergen line for the standard 中華そば.

staff_allergy_handling.text: The company does publish an アレルギー情報 block per dish on the branch page — unusual for a ramen counter — so an English-speaking visitor can at least read the allergen set before ordering, even though the answer for wheat is no.

cultural_comfort.note: Tokyo Ramen Street is the easiest ramen environment in the city for a visitor: 124 m inside Tokyo Station's Yaesu basement, ticket machine at the door, photo-led menu, all counter, all non-smoking, and constant foreign traffic. No reservations. Cash or transit IC only — no credit cards and no QR payment — so carry a Suica or notes. Open from 08:30, which makes it one of the few places to eat a proper bowl before a morning Shinkansen.

enrich_note: Confirmed, name unchanged. Yahoo Japan returned Tabelog 13227565 and the group site; s.tabelog.com fetched with an iPhone UA (HTTP 200) gives the address, phone 03-6551-2205, 30 seats, the 2018-10-30 open date and GeoCoordinates 35.68006969871725 / 139.76797347437162, which replace the centroid pin. gyoku.co.jp (HTTP 200) confirms the shop is trading and supplies the per-item allergen data used above; the PR TIMES release of 2018-10-27 (HTTP 200) supplies the founder and the brand history. One display caution: the operator's own site now titles this branch 玉 東京駅店, while Tabelog and the light record use the original 東京煮干し らーめん玉 東京駅店 — both refer to the same counter, and 東京煮干ラーメン玉 is the menu brand. loc_precise set true.

name: 俺式 純
address_ja: 〒100-0005 東京都千代田区丸の内1-9-1 東京駅一番街 B1F 東京ラーメンストリート
cuisine: Setagaya's tonkotsu shop on Tokyo Ramen Street — pork bones boiled in-house for over 24 hours against a low-hydration thin noodle, with a house chilli-bean rāyu of eighteen ingredients on the counter and a 替玉 refill; morning ramen from 08:00, around ¥1,000–1,999
neighborhood: Marunouchi 1-chōme, Tokyo Ramen Street on the B1 of Tokyo Station Ichibangai — 107 m from Tokyo Station; left out of the Yaesu south gate and down the stairs, or right out of the Yaesu underground central gate
hours_raw: 08:00 - 23:00（L.O. 22:30）毎日。定休日：なし。※8:00～10:30は通常メニューの販売は無し。朝ラーメンのみ販売。
gf_detail: The shop publishes a proper アレルギー物質使用一覧表 for this branch and it closes the question: every ramen row — ラーメン, チャーシュー麺, デラックスラーメン, やりすぎ煮干しラーメン(DX), 照り焼きチャーシュー麺, 豚郎ラーメン, スタミナつけ麺, 黒マー油ラーメン — carries 小麦, and so does the 替玉 refill. The group's own copy says the noodle is chosen for its flour: 「しなやかで風味豊かな俺式の低加水麺は、小麦粉やブレンドにこだわり」. The chart's own footnotes rule out working around it: 「同一店内で仕込みから調理、提供までを行っております」, 「揚げ物はすべて同じフライヤーで揚げています。その他、調理の過程において商品間・原材料間でのアレルギー物質の偶発的混入の可能性がございます」. The one curiosity is that 半ライス and 明太子ご飯 are printed with no allergen marks at all, but plain rice beside a 24-hour pork broth is not a meal and no separation is claimed. Not workable for celiac.
vegan_detail: The broth is 新鮮な豚骨のみ boiled in the shop for more than 24 hours, the popular variant adds a large charge of dried sardine, and chāshū and egg run through the toppings — the published allergen chart marks 豚肉 on every ramen row. Nothing plant-based is offered and none is claimed.

roles: 代表 (president), 株式会社せたが屋 — founded 1 May 2003, Okusawa, Setagaya-ku
creator of the せたが屋 / ひるがお / 俺式 group of brands
chef_bio.origin: Setagaya, Tokyo — the company is still registered at Okusawa 5-chōme, Jiyūgaoka
chef_bio.background: 俺式 is the tonkotsu arm of せたが屋, the Setagaya group Maejima established as a company on 1 May 2003 and has since spread across Japan and overseas, alongside the lighter 中華そば brands ひるがお, 中華そば ふくもり, 極上中華そば 福味, ラーメン家 がんくろ, 中華そば いま瀬 and 食堂はせ川 — several of which also trade inside Tokyo Station's basements, so the group effectively runs both the delicate and the heavy end of the same station. 俺式's own stated method is narrow and specific: fresh pork bones only, boiled in the shop's own kitchen for more than 24 hours until the broth is dense but round rather than sharp; a low-hydration noodle blended for flour character and cut to resist going soft, so the last mouthful eats like the first; and a house-made 特製ラー醤 on every table, a chilli paste built from eighteen ingredients for heat plus texture. The offshoot that made the shop's name is 「やりすぎ煮干しラーメン」 — the same thick pork broth with an excessive quantity of dried sardine thrown in. The Tokyo Station branch opened 20 September 2013 and now opens at 08:00, though the normal menu does not start until 10:30; before that it sells a morning ramen only.
chef_bio.philosophy: One stock, done at length, in the shop — 新鮮な豚骨のみを使用し、店内厨房で24時間以上じっくりと炊き出したスープ — and a noodle chosen so it holds to the bottom of the bowl.
chef_bio.specialty: とんこつラーメン, やりすぎ煮干しラーメン, 黒マー油ラーメン, スタミナつけ麺, 朝ラーメン, 卓上特製ラー醤.

anecdotes.text: The counter condiment is the shop's calling card: 「卓上に置かれた手作り特製ラー醤は、程よい辛味と18種類の食材が織りなす旨味と食感が特徴」.

A 2026 Tabelog reviewer arriving at Tokyo Station on a wet Sunday morning describes it as ライトな豚骨、朝食にもアジャストするラーメン — a tonkotsu light enough to work as breakfast, which is what the 08:00 opening is for.
Tabelog tags the shop 一人で入りやすい — easy to walk into alone — which for a station tonkotsu counter with 14 counter seats is the whole proposition.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: setaga-ya.com's 俺式 page gives the Tokyo Station branch's address (東京都千代田区丸の内1-9-1 東京駅一番街 地下一階 ラーメンストリート内), phone 03-3212-2558, 定休日なし, hours 8:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30) with the note that the normal menu does not start until 10:30, seat breakdown (カウンター14席 / テーブル2人8席), the broth and noodle method and the 18-ingredient rāyu; it also links a per-item allergen table image for this exact branch. The company page gives 株式会社せたが屋, 設立 平成15年5月1日, 代表 前島司, 〒158-0083 東京都世田谷区奥沢5丁目26-3. Tabelog 13160396 adds 予約不可, カード不可 / 交通系電子マネー可 / QR不可, 全席禁煙, 子供可, open date 2013年9月20日 and GeoCoordinates 35.68020681871714 / 139.76790376437305.

gf_cross_contamination.text: The shop's own allergen sheet states it outright: 「同一店内で仕込みから調理、提供までを行っております」 and 「揚げ物はすべて同じフライヤーで揚げています。その他、調理の過程において商品間・原材料間でのアレルギー物質の偶発的混入の可能性がございます」 — one kitchen, one fryer, incidental transfer acknowledged.
Thirty seats behind one noodle boiler running from 08:00 to 23:00, with a 替玉 noodle refill service that puts more wheat through the same water all day.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: 大豆 is marked on every ramen row of the allergen chart alongside 小麦; the tare is ordinary soy-based seasoning and no tamari is named. The counter ラー醤 carries the widest allergen set on the sheet, so it is not a safe default addition either.

vegan_cross_contact.text: 豚肉 is marked on every ramen row; the base is fresh pork bone boiled 24 hours in the shop's own kitchen, with chāshū and egg among the standard toppings.

staff_allergy_handling.text: Genuinely better than the norm for a station ramen counter: the branch publishes a printed per-item アレルギー物質使用一覧表 covering the 8 特定原材料 and the 20 準ずるもの, item by item, and closes it with 「アレルギー物質に対する感受性は、個人により大きな差があります。このデータを参考に、最終的な判断は専門医に相談されることをおすすめします」 — it hands you the data and declines to make the call for you, which is the honest position.

cultural_comfort.note: About as easy as a Japanese ramen counter gets for a visitor: 107 m inside Tokyo Station's Yaesu basement on Tokyo Ramen Street, ticket machine at the door, 14 counter seats plus four two-tops, all non-smoking, children accepted, and Tabelog's own tag is 一人で入りやすい. No reservations. Cash or transit IC only — no credit cards, no QR payment. It opens at 08:00 but only sells a morning ramen until 10:30, so arriving early does not get you the full menu. The printed allergen sheet is a picture on the group's website rather than something handed to you, so screenshot it before you go.

enrich_note: Confirmed, name unchanged. Note the group's Google Maps link on its own page points at 35.6801865 / 139.7678609, ~20 m from the Tabelog coordinate; same doorway. loc_precise set true.

name: 六厘舎 東京駅東京ラーメンストリート
address_ja: 〒100-0005 東京都千代田区丸の内1-9-1 東京駅一番街 B1F 東京ラーメンストリート内
cuisine: The shop that turned thick-dip tsukemen into a national style — a pork-and-fish dip reduced until the solids are crushed out of shape, against a coarse extra-thick curly noodle; the queue starts at 07:30 for the morning-only bowl, and a standard tsukemen runs about ¥1,000–1,999
neighborhood: Marunouchi 1-chōme, Tokyo Ramen Street on the B1 of Tokyo Station Ichibangai — 120 m from Tokyo Station; right out of the Yaesu central south gate and down the stairs, or right out of the Yaesu underground central gate to the far end
hours_raw: 月・火・水・木・金・土・日・祝日・祝前日 07:30 - 09:45（L.O. 料理09:30）／10:00 - 23:00（L.O. 料理22:30）。運営会社の告知は通常営業を「7:30～23:00（L.O.22:30）」と一本で表記しており、施設の排気設備メンテナンス等で不定期に短縮される（例：2026年2月3日は7:30～20:00、2月4日は11:00開店）。
gf_detail: Wheat is the entire proposition. The brand's own description of itself is a 極太縮れ麺 built strong enough to stand up to the dip, and a 2026 Tabelog reviewer describes it plainly as 「麺は小麦の風味が豊かで、もちもちとした」 — a noodle sold on how much the wheat reads. The dip is a long-boiled pork-bone-and-fish reduction finished with ordinary wheat shōyu tare; no tamari is named anywhere. To the group's credit it publishes a downloadable allergen chart at rokurinsha.com/storage/rokurinsha-allergen.pdf, but it is a scanned table this pass could not machine-read, so it is cited here as something to consult rather than summarised. Nothing gluten-free is claimed and there is no rice-noodle option. Not workable for celiac.
vegan_detail: A 豚骨魚介 dip — pork bone and dried fish reduced together over many hours, with pork chāshū and a half egg among the standard toppings. Nothing plant-based is offered and none is claimed.

roles: 六厘舎 — tsukemen brand of 株式会社松富士食品 (Matsufuji Corp.)
sister brands 舎鈴, ジャンクガレッジ, トナリ, 次念序, 久臨; no individual chef is named for the Tokyo Station counter
chef_bio.origin: Tokyo — the brand's own account is of a shop whose dip has been altered continuously since it opened, without telling the customer
chef_bio.background: 六厘舎 is the shop most often credited with establishing the thick-broth tsukemen style now found across Japan; its own copy makes the claim directly — 「現在の全国的に流行りつつあるつけめんの濃厚スープスタイルを六厘舎が確立したと言っても過言ではない」 — and describes the result, with some relish, as ガサツで荒々しく男らしいつけめん, a coarse, rough, unrefined bowl. The method is quantity and time: a very large volume of ingredients boiled for a very long time, and then, at the end, crushed by hand until the solids lose their shape entirely so that every last bit of flavour is beaten out of them. What is less known is that the dip is not fixed. The brand states it has been shifting the taste in increments since opening, deliberately below the threshold at which a regular would notice, and that ingredient selection, preparation and boiling method today are 「開店当初とは180度違う」 — a hundred and eighty degrees from where they started. The Tokyo Station branch opened 17 June 2009 and has been named to Tabelog's ラーメン百名店 every year from 2017 to 2025; it is now part of Matsufuji Corp., which also runs 舎鈴, ジャンクガレッジ, トナリ and 次念序, and it sells a morning-only bowl from 07:30 that has its own following.
chef_bio.philosophy: 「つけめんを文化に」— make tsukemen a culture, not a fad; and 「最後の一滴まで美味しく頂ける」, a dip that has to still be worth drinking at the bottom.
chef_bio.specialty: つけめん (pork-bone and fish dip, extra-thick curly noodle), 味玉つけめん, 生七味つけめん, 朝つけめん (morning-only), retail noodle and soup sets.

anecdotes.text: The brand admits to moving the target without telling anyone: 「開店当初よりお客様に気づかれぬよう、または違和感を与えないよう微妙に味変えをし日々進化させてきております…開店当初とは180度違う今も尚進化を探求し続ける現在進行形の味」.
A 2026 Tabelog reviewer on a Sunday evening: 「19時着で入店までに45分ほどかかった」 — 45 minutes to get in, and their verdict was that the branch tastes like the real thing, inside a railway station.
The finishing step is manual: after the long boil 「最後に職人の手により素材のかたちがなくなるまで潰して素材の旨み全て叩き出します」 — the ingredients are crushed until they have no shape left.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: Tabelog 13093047 gives 東京都千代田区丸の内1-9-1 東京駅一番街 B1F 東京ラーメンストリート内, phone 03-3286-0166, 26 seats (カウンター10席、2人掛けテーブル8卓), 予約不可, カード不可 / 交通系電子マネー可 / QR不可, 全席禁煙, バリアフリー, 朝食・モーニングあり, テイクアウト, open date 2009年6月17日, homepage rokurinsha.com, ラーメン百名店 2017–2025, and GeoCoordinates 35.680061328717215 / 139.76785429437163. The operator's own store page (shop.mtfj.co.jp/stores/61) gives postcode 100-0005, the same address and phone, 26 seats, 決済方法 現金 and the full weekly 7:30–23:00 schedule. rokurinsha.com carries the brand's own history, method and the allergen PDF link; mtfj.co.jp/news/news-15507/ (20 Jan 2026) documents a facility-driven hours change at this exact branch.

gf_cross_contamination.text: Twenty-six seats turning a queue from 07:30 to 23:00 behind a single noodle boiler running extra-thick wheat noodles continuously. No wheat-free line, no separate equipment, nothing published about separation.

soy_sauce_wheat.text: The dip is a long-reduced pork-and-fish stock finished with ordinary wheat shōyu tare; no gluten-free tamari is named on the brand site, the operator's store page or the listing.

vegan_cross_contact.text: Pork bone and dried fish are boiled together as the base of the only product the shop sells, with pork chāshū on the standard bowl.

staff_allergy_handling.text: The brand does publish a downloadable アレルゲン情報 chart (rokurinsha.com/storage/rokurinsha-allergen.pdf) — worth pulling up before ordering, though it is a scan and could not be read as text here.

positives.text: Tabelog lists the shop as バリアフリー and it has an English-language version of its brand site, which is rare for a queueing ramen counter.

cultural_comfort.note: The single most-queued bowl in Tokyo Station: 120 m inside the Yaesu basement, ticket machine at the door, all non-smoking, listed as barrier-free, children accepted, takeaway available, and an English site if you want to read the menu first. Expect to wait — a Sunday-evening arrival at 19:00 in 2026 took 45 minutes to get a seat — and expect no reservations. Cash or transit IC only: the operator's own store page lists 決済方法 現金 and Tabelog confirms カード不可 / QR不可. Hours are the one thing not to trust in advance: the branch is subject to the building's ventilation-maintenance closures and the operator posts one-off changes on mtfj.co.jp, so check the day you go.

enrich_note: Confirmed, with the name normalised to the Tabelog / landlord form (六厘舎 東京駅東京ラーメンストリート; the operator's own store list calls it 六厘舎 東京ラーメンストリート店). Yahoo Japan returned Tabelog 13093047 and the operator's store page; both fetched HTTP 200 and agree on 東京都千代田区丸の内1-9-1 東京駅一番街 B1F, phone 03-3286-0166 and 26 seats. Tabelog's GeoCoordinates 35.680061328717215 / 139.76785429437163 replace the centroid pin. hours_status is 'irregular' deliberately: Tabelog splits the day 07:30–09:45 then 10:00–23:00 while the operator publishes it as one 7:30–23:00 block, and the operator's own 2026-01-20 notice shows the branch closing early or opening late for building ventilation maintenance. No individual chef is named by any source, so chef_name is left null rather than guessed. name: 四川担担麺 阿吽 キッテグランシェ店
address_ja: 〒100-7090 東京都千代田区丸の内2-7-2 JPタワー KITTE丸の内 B1F
cuisine: Closed. While it traded, this was the Tokyo Station branch of Yushima's 四川担担麺 阿吽 — a sesame-heavy Sichuan tantanmen with heat (辣油) and numbing (花椒) each dialled 0 to 6 on the ticket machine, standard bowl ¥980
neighborhood: Marunouchi 2-chōme, the KITTE GRANCHE food floor in the JP Tower basement — 244 m from Tokyo Station, connected underground to the Marunouchi line. The unit is no longer listed among KITTE's ramen tenants.
gf_detail: Recorded for completeness, since the shop is shut. Tantanmen is a wheat-noodle dish and this one was built on a low-hydration straight wheat noodle; the sesame broth was carried on a chilli-and-dòubànjiàng base, and dòubànjiàng is fermented with wheat flour as a matter of course. No gluten-free claim was ever published.
vegan_detail: Recorded for completeness. The bowl was minced pork over sesame broth with mizuna; nothing plant-based was offered.

roles: branch of 四川担担麺 阿吽, whose 本店 is in Yushima, Bunkyō-ku
no individual chef named for the KITTE counter
chef_bio.background: 阿吽 built its reputation in Yushima and is widely credited in Japanese ramen writing with driving the 汁なし担担麺 (soupless tantanmen) boom; a Tabelog reviewer sums up the standing as 「汁なし担々麺ブームを作った立役者であり、クオリティは都内最高レベル」, a shop that satisfies people who know Sichuan cooking as well as ramen regulars. The KITTE branch sat in the basement zone KITTE marketed as its ラーメン激戦区 — a five-shop ramen row alongside 松戸富田麺絆, 中華そば 福味 and かね田 — and worked from a ticket machine with photographs, letting the customer pick heat and numbing separately on a 0-to-6 scale, which the house recommended at 辛さ3・痺れ2. The bowl was a thick, creamy sesame broth cut with chilli oil, minced pork worked with dòubànjiàng and Sichuan pepper, mizuna, and a low-hydration straight noodle. It closed at the end of February 2024; the Yushima parent is a separate business and this record makes no claim about it.
chef_bio.specialty: 担担麺 (¥980), 汁なし担担麺, つゆ無し味玉味噌担担麺.

anecdotes.text: The ticket machine did the work an allergy conversation could not: heat and numbing were each selectable 0–6, so 「誰でも自分好みの味が見つけられそう」 — but nothing on it addressed ingredients.
A regular's verdict in Feb 2024, weeks before it shut: 「ここ3年ほど、こちらの坦々麺を上回るものを見つけていません」 — three years of looking and nothing better.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: Tabelog 13231656 is headed 【閉店】 and states 「このお店は現在閉店しております」; it records the address 東京都千代田区丸の内2-7-2 JPタワー KITTE丸の内 B1F, 予約不可, hours 11:00–21:50 weekdays / 11:00–20:50 weekends, budget ～￥999, GeoCoordinates 35.67968983791123 / 139.76520288320796, and no review later than February 2024. The Japanese blog 酒走 (reerac.net), which visited in October 2022, carries a dated correction at the head of its post: 「※「四川担々麺 阿吽 キッテグランシェ店」は2024年2月末に閉店しました」. KITTE's own ラーメン tenant list no longer contains 阿吽, and the landlord's news item about the shop (item_eventnews.jsp?id=297) has expired.

cultural_comfort.note: Closed — do not send anyone. If a visitor turns up at the old unit in KITTE's basement, the neighbouring shops in the same ramen row (松戸富田麺絆, 鶏soba 座銀, 中華そば 福味) are still trading; a 2026 Tabelog reviewer records coming for 阿吽, finding it gone, and eating next door instead.
